boxes.text: Welcome to AudioRite. Each box is one clip. Press Convert, and this text is read out loud.
boxes.label: Welcome

boxes.text: Change a word and only that box is made again. The rest stay as they are.
Speakers each have their own voice. I'm Sam.
And I'm Emma. Pick a voice for each of us in the bar at the top.
When you're happy, save the clips and drop them into your video editor.
Boxes can also sit on their own, outside any scene.
